methodology.approach: deterministic one-shot editorial curation assisted by constraint-preserving local search; result is frozen explicitly and does not depend on runtime heuristics
methodology.signature_preservation: Main-meal plant status and pasta/rice primary-carb class are preserved during replacements to protect rolling hard constraints.
methodology.shopping_reuse: Isolated package-sensitive dairy is removed where possible; dormant ingredients are activated in reusable clusters.
